author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Want to transcribe audio to text for free on your PC with no uploads or subscriptions? In this step-by-step tutorial, I’ll show you how to use a free app called Vibe to convert audio or video into text instantly.

This tool runs entirely on your computer, so your files stay private and you can transcribe unlimited content. It works on Windows, Mac, and Linux and uses one of the most accurate AI transcription models available.

In this video, you’ll learn how to:
- Install and set up Vibe
- Transcribe audio and video files
- Export transcripts in different formats
- Automatically summarize transcripts
- Detect multiple speakers
- Translate audio into English

Whether you're creating captions, transcribing meetings, or working with interviews, this is one of the easiest and most powerful free solutions available.
